work.title: Case studies
work.description: Two cases in detail. An AI quality control platform in Dutch agritech and a mobile and web product at a sportstech startup.

hero.headline: What we have built.
hero.lead: Two projects in detail. The problem, what we built, and the numbers.

cases.client: AI quality control platform for a Dutch agritech company
cases.role: One senior engineer, end to end
cases.summary: Problem: industrial clients needed automated, 24/7 quality control on image data, in environments that each had their own security requirements. What we built: the full stack around computer-vision inference. NestJS API, Vue.js annotation interface, PostgreSQL, CI/CD and a hybrid deployment across Azure and on-premise. Production services and large image datasets were migrated to new hardware with zero data loss.
cases.approach: NVIDIA Triton for model serving (ResNet and YOLO), a modular NestJS API and a data pipeline with OCR and validation agents. Designed for high throughput with cost and reliability in mind.

cases.production: In production since Q3 2023 · zero-downtime deployments

cases.client: Mobile app, back office and website for a sportstech startup
cases.summary: Problem: an early-stage startup had to launch a mobile app, a back office and a public website at the same time, with a team that still had to be built. What we built: the React Native app with Unity game features, the React and Next.js back office and the website, on a NestJS backend with OAuth2 and Firebase Auth.
cases.approach: Architecture, sprint planning and code reviews for a team of 7 to 12 engineers. CI/CD on AWS and role-based access across mobile and web.
cases.production: Live on the App Store and Google Play · 2022 to 2023

bio: Jaize Tech is a compact AI studio in IJlst, Friesland. We build AI features that reach production and stay there. Small enough to move fast, senior enough to own the whole system: model, API, frontend and infrastructure.

The studio was founded by A. Jaize, an engineer with five years of production software behind him. The last 2.5 years as the sole engineer on an AI computer-vision platform at a Dutch agritech company, before that as tech lead of a team of 7 to 12 engineers at a sportstech startup. He leads every package himself.

terms.title: Terms of engagement
terms.description: Terms of engagement for working with Jaize Tech, a sole proprietorship of A. Jaize based in IJlst, Netherlands.
terms.headline: Terms
terms.intro: Short, clear terms for working with me. No fine print, no legal theatre. If something isn't clear, just ask.

sections.p: Jaize Tech is a sole proprietorship of A. Jaize, software engineer. Based in IJlst, Friesland. KvK 42051769.

Software engineering, AI features, infrastructure work, and related technical services. We agree the scope of each engagement up front. What I'm not delivering goes in the proposal too, so there's no room for confusion.
Prices are fixed per engagement and agreed up front. No hidden costs. Invoicing happens per project or monthly for ongoing work. Payment terms are 14 days from invoice date unless we agree otherwise.
Something needs to change mid-engagement? No problem. We run a short change request with adjusted price and timeline. Both sides sign before the work shifts.
All code and deliverables I build for you belong to you once payment is complete. I may reference the work anonymously in my portfolio, unless we agree otherwise.
What you share with me stays between us. I'm happy to sign an NDA if you'd prefer. I expect the same from you for anything I show you during our conversations.

My liability is limited to the value of the specific engagement. I do my work as carefully as I can, but I don't guarantee outcomes from third parties like AI models, external APIs, or cloud providers.
If either of us wants to stop the engagement, put it in writing. Work already completed gets invoiced up to the cancellation date.
Dutch law applies to these terms. Disputes go to the competent court in Friesland.
Questions about these terms? Email me at abdellah@jaizetech.nl. I reply within 24 hours on business days.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.description: How Jaize Tech handles personal data from visitors and clients. A short, honest explanation. Analytics only with your consent.
privacy.headline: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: Short explanation of what data I process and why. No pages of legal text. Just what you actually need to know.

sections.p: A. Jaize, sole proprietorship Jaize Tech, based in IJlst, Netherlands. KvK 42051769. For questions about your data: abdellah@jaizetech.nl.

What you fill in on the contact form: name, email address, optionally company name, and your message. For site statistics I use PostHog (servers in the EU). Without your consent it runs cookie-free: no cookies, no local storage, and your IP address is hashed, not stored. If you accept cookies in the banner, PostHog also records a replay of your visit (clicks, scrolling, page changes; everything you type is masked) and sets a cookie so it recognises your browser for a year. Changed your mind? Clear this site's cookies and site data in your browser and the banner asks again.
To read your message and reply. Nothing more, nothing less.
Until our conversation ends, then up to 2 more years for record-keeping. Want me to delete your data sooner? Send a mail and I'll do it within a week.

With Brevo for sending emails (they deliver my reply), with Cloudflare for hosting this site, and with PostHog (EU) for statistics and, only after your consent, session replays. That's it. No advertising networks, no data brokers, no selling of data.

You have the right to access, correct, and delete your data. You can also object to processing. Email abdellah@jaizetech.nl and I'll handle it within a week. Not satisfied? You can complain to the Dutch Data Protection Authority (Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens).

Messages you send via the contact form go through an encrypted connection. I store your data in my email (Gmail with 2FA) and nowhere else. If there were ever a data breach, I'd report it within 72 hours per GDPR rules.
If I update this policy, the date at the top changes. Significant changes get announced on my site.
